transcript.text: Alright everyone, let's get this coordination huddle going. We've got Alpha and Bravo recerts next week, and two available training blocks: Monday 0800-1200 and Tuesday 1300-1700. I need to publish the final schedule, so let's figure out what we know. First question — who do we have available to evaluate Alpha? Bravo's evaluator will be confirmed through battalion training after this huddle, so we don't need to worry about that one right now. What else do I need to know before I lock this in?
